The '''Quarren Trawler''' was a [[Quarren]] who worked on the [[Water|ice]] [[planet]] [[Pagodon]] and harassed a [[The Fledgling Mythrol|Mythrol]] in a [[Boatman's Reach|public house]] there alongside two other trawlers. The trawlers planned to cut off the Mythrol's gills and sell them, but before they could, the [[bounty hunter]] known as [[Din Djarin|the Mandalorian]] entered the bar and distracted them. The [[Alpha Trawler]] then declared the [[Mandalorian]] had spilt his drink, and when the bounty hunter ignored him, the trio of trawlers surrounded the Mandalorian. The hunter then quickly defeated the trio and [[Death|killed]] the Quarren perpetrator, who attempted to flee.

==Biography==
===Harassing a Mythrol===
{{Quote|Look at his glands! I bet we could sell them at the port.|translated=1|The lead trawler points out the Mythrol's gills to the Quarren|<ref name="Mando1" />}}
[[File:Trawler_Trio.png|thumb|left|The Quarren harassed a Mythrol with two other trawlers.|250px]]
A [[Quarren]] worked as a trawler on the [[Water|ice]] [[planet]] [[Pagodon]] following the collapse of the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[9 ABY]], the Quarren harassed a [[The Fledgling Mythrol|Mythrol]] in a [[Boatman's Reach|public house]] at the settlement [[Ferryman's Reach]] on the [[planet]] alongside two [[human]] trawlers. The perpetrator held the Mythrol down on the table, while the [[Alpha Trawler]] of the harassment noted that they could sell the Mythrol's gills at the nearby [[Spaceport|port]]. Though he attempted to surrender the [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] he was carrying to the trio, the Mythrol was ignored, with the Quarren pulling him to his feet so the lead human could cut him with a [[knife]].<ref name="Mando1" />

Before the trawlers could cut the Mythrol, the [[bounty hunter]] known as [[Din Djarin|the Mandalorian]] entered the bar, drawing the attention of the lead trawler. The Quarren kept hold of the Mythrol while the lead trawler approached the Mandalorian, claiming the bounty hunter had spilled his drink. When the [[Mandalorian]] ignored him, the lead trawler signaled over the Quarren and the [[Beta Trawler]].<ref name="Mando1" />

===A bar fight gone bad===
[[File:Quarren_Trawler_death.png|thumb|right|The Quarren was sliced in half by a closing door.|250px]]
The Quarren dropped the Mythrol onto the table before approaching the bar, with the intention of surrounding the Mandalorian. The establishment's [[Unidentified bartender (Pagodon)|bartender]] offered the trawler a replacement drink for free, but when he slid the drink toward the human, the Mandalorian caught it mid slid and threw the contents in the Quarren's face. This caused the trawler to stumble back while the Mandalorian smashed the empty mug over the head of the second human trawler, before grabbing hold of and slamming the head of the Quarren into the bar. Though the lead trawler then attempted to stab the Mandalorian, the bounty hunter blocked the knife, redirecting it into the trawler's own back.<ref name="Mando1" />

With the Quarren's comrades defeated, the trawler attempted to flee but was caught by the bounty hunter's [[whipcord launcher]] as it passed through the bar's door and fell to the ground. As the hunter pulled the Quarren back through the door, the trawler pulled out a [[blaster pistol]] and fired at the him, though the shot was deflected by his [[Mandalorian armor]]. The hunter then shot the door control with his own [[blaster]], causing it to close on the Quarren, who proceeded to be sliced in half and [[Death|died]].<ref name="Mando1" />

==Personality and traits==
With [[Color|orange]] skin and green [[eye]]s, the Quarren attempted to flee from the Mandalorian after seeing the other trawlers beaten.<ref name="Mando1" />

==Equipment==
The Quarren carried a blaster pistol and wore a brown [[Clothing|jacket]] over a black shirt, as well as black pants and [[boot]]s.<ref name="Mando1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Quarren Trawler was portrayed by [[Dmitrious Bistrevsky]] in [[Chapter 1: The Mandalorian|Chapter 1]] of the [[2019]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'',<ref name="Mando1" /> which aired on [[November 12]], 2019.<ref name="DTCI">{{WebCite|url=https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf|text=The Mandalorian Media Kit|work=[https://dtcimedia.disney.com Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International]|archivedate=20230315011507}}</ref>
